claims.content: The system allows the customer to view available auction items, place bids (QuickBid, SmartBid), and monitor their bidding activity.

goal.raw_text: The system allows the customer to view available auction items, place bids (QuickBid, SmartBid), and monitor their bidding activity.

claims.content:
The customer is on the JTVauctions.com site.
The customer has a valid account (implied by the requirement to sign in before placing a bid).

preconditions.raw_text:
The customer is on the JTVauctions.com site.
The customer has a valid account (implied by the requirement to sign in before placing a bid).

claims.content: The customer navigates to a product details page for an item that is currently up for auction.

trigger.raw_text: The customer navigates to a product details page for an item that is currently up for auction.

claims.content:
The customer views the product details page.
The system displays the SKU Creation Field Names, Product Details Page Label, and Example Data for the item (e.g., Gemstone Color, Stone Ct).
The system displays the Bidding Section, including the Opening Bid, Current Winning Bid, and Countdown clock.
The customer places a bid using either the 'QuickBid Now' button or the 'SmartBid' field.
The system displays a bid confirmation pop-up message showing the bid amount and type.
The customer confirms the bid.
The system displays the Item Bid History, showing bidder member IDs, bid amounts, and times.

main_flow.raw_text:
The customer views the product details page.
The system displays the SKU Creation Field Names, Product Details Page Label, and Example Data for the item (e.g., Gemstone Color, Stone Ct).
The system displays the Bidding Section, including the Opening Bid, Current Winning Bid, and Countdown clock.
The customer places a bid using either the 'QuickBid Now' button or the 'SmartBid' field.
The system displays a bid confirmation pop-up message showing the bid amount and type.
The customer confirms the bid.
The system displays the Item Bid History, showing bidder member IDs, bid amounts, and times.

claims.content:
2a. Customer navigates from the Homepage or Category Links: The customer clicks on boxes for 'Jewelry Auctions', 'Watch Auctions', or 'Gemstone Auctions' to view relevant items.
2b. Customer uses Search: The customer searches by item attributes (product ID, description, etc.) to find items. If no results are found, the system provides a 'Popular Searches' list.
3a. Customer views product attributes: The system displays specific attributes for the product type, such as 'Bracelets' attributes like Metal Purity, Metal Color, and Stone Group.
4a. Customer uses QuickBid: The system places a single bid adding the stated bid increment to the last bid.
4b. Customer uses SmartBid: The system places bids up to the customer's set maximum bid amount, including in overtime bidding.

claims.content:
4a. Customer not signed in: Before allowing a bid to be placed, the system checks the bidder's sign-in status. If not signed in, the system takes the bidder to the sign-in page.
2c. No Internet Connection or Product Error: The customer sees an error message stating 'There was a problem with your request. We are sorry that this auction item is not available at this time. Please try again later.'

2c. No Internet Connection or Product Error: The customer sees an error message stating 'There was a problem with your request. We are sorry that this auction item is not available at this time. Please try again later.'

claims.content:
The bid is recorded in the system.
The Item Bid History is updated on the product page.
The customer's bid history is updated (if the user is signed in).
